records.text: Donald Trump said he posted an AI image because he thought it depicted him as a doctor and Red Cross worker making people better.
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

verification.notes: AP and video reporting directly confirm Trump said he thought the AI image showed him as a doctor or Red Cross worker making people better.

sources.title: Trump says he will not apologize to Pope Leo and explains his reason for posting much-criticized meme
